name: Yantian Zha

fitReason: Robotics-AI methodological backup for the Assistant Professor priority. Strong reinforcement learning and language/gesture-to-task methods; inspected experiments do not establish learned execution on a current NC A&T robot.

physicalEvidence.summary: AAM-SEALS uses SAC and reinforcement learning from demonstrations for cross-medium navigation and manipulation in simulation. Physical 3D-printed unpowered free-fall tests validate hydrodynamics, not an executed learned policy; functional robot transfer remains future work. NatSGLD uses a Unity3D kitchen and hidden human operator to collect speech/gesture demonstrations. Its appendix evaluates T5 and BART language-to-LTL understanding. Neither the synthetic robot nor the separate passive tank tests establish autonomous physical learning.

name: Mingjun Li
title: Assistant Professor of Computing Sciences
department: Computing Sciences, College of Engineering, Technology, and Architecture
fitReason: Newly appointed spatial-AI backup. His core verified methods infer and forecast human motion for VR systems; direct robot control and current robot access are unverified. The security application is narrower than a general robot-learning agenda.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full 2025 study uses OpenPose body joints from external video and an Informer-based Transformer to predict controller trajectories, then applies neural authentication. Evaluation reuses a human VR ball-throwing dataset, not robot actuation. A full May 2026 Hartford-affiliated paper trains a one-dimensional fully convolutional discriminator on real and forecast 3D controller trajectories across three VR systems. These are spatial motion-learning experiments on recorded human behavior, not an actuated robot demonstration.

shortVisit.summary: The official current biography describes research and mentoring, but no separate external-master summer or visiting-student invitation was verified. Prior mentoring during his doctorate is not a present Hartford offer.

scoreReasons.fit: Substantive spatial trajectory learning and human behavior modeling; less direct robot-learning fit.
scoreReasons.physical: Human VR recordings and forecasting do not establish executed robot learning.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No explicit outside-master research visitor invitation verified.
